permissions.purpose: Reads your unpaid and past-due invoices from the last 90 days so the audit can count how many failed and what they were worth. Nothing is created, changed or voided.

Reads the decline code on each failed charge. This is the whole point of the audit: nine of Stripe's decline codes can never be recovered by retrying, and this is the only way to tell how many of yours are in that group.
Reads subscription status and billing interval so failed renewals can be told apart from one-off invoices, which behave differently and need different handling.
